operation.summary: Change settings (agents with Agent Super Powers, once the owner turns on App settings); every change is checked first, so one bad change changes nothing

body.name: changes
body.description: {"<key>": <value>, ...}, up to 50; keys and allowed values from GET /v1/settings

operation.returns: changed[key, from, to], unchanged, settings (as in GET)

changes.description: {"<key>": <value>, ...}, up to 50; keys and allowed values from GET /v1/settings

idempotency_key.description: Any UUID; repeating the call with the same key within 24 h returns the first result instead of acting twice
